# SOP-P1-L3-04 Shift handover - Machining line

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P1, line P1-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L3-IH01, EQ-P1-L3-HP02, EQ-P1-L3-CN03  
Related documents: ECN-2026-008, MM-P1-L3-IH01, QS-PROC-04

Purpose
- To standardize the shift handover process for the Machining line to ensure continuity of safe operation, product quality, and traceability.

Scope
- Applies to all operators, lead technicians, and supervisors assigned to Plant P1, line P1-L3 and to the equipment identified: EQ-P1-L3-IH01, EQ-P1-L3-HP02, EQ-P1-L3-CN03.

Background and rationale
- The machining line produces forged billets that require controlled heating, hydraulic press operation, and machining. Consistent transfer of process state, outstanding actions, and known issues reduces risk of equipment damage, rejects, and safety incidents. Handover also ensures lubrication and temperature controls are verified against baseline records. The lubricant part number for Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02) is CFW-LUB-497. The target billet temperature for Machining induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P1-L3-IH01) is 1235 °C. These values must be confirmed during each handover and recorded.

Preconditions (to be completed before handover)
1. The oncoming operator has reviewed the last shift log and read any open entries in the shift binder.
2. All in-process billets are identified and the current process step is documented.
3. Any required parts, tooling, or consumables for the next shift are staged or ordered per MM-P1-L3-IH01.
4. Safety devices and guards are in place; no safety bypass is active.
5. Outstanding maintenance requests have been logged in accordance with ECN-2026-008 and communicated to maintenance.

Personal protective equipment (PPE)
1. Hard hat, safety glasses, hearing protection, and steel-toe footwear are required on the machining floor.
2. Gloves appropriate for handling hot materials must be worn when handling billets removed from EQ-P1-L3-IH01.
3. Additional PPE for maintenance tasks must follow MM-P1-L3-IH01 and QS-PROC-04.

Numbered handover steps
1. Initial briefing
   - The outgoing operator provides a concise verbal summary of the last shift, including production status, any deviations, and known work-arounds.
   - Confirm all critical alarms, trips, and interlocks that occurred and the current status of restoration.
   - Note any quality concerns observed during the last shift and the disposition of suspect parts.

2. Equipment status verification
   - Inspect EQ-P1-L3-IH01, EQ-P1-L3-HP02, and EQ-P1-L3-CN03 for visible damage, leaks, or abnormal conditions.
   - Confirm lubrication status of EQ-P1-L3-HP02 and verify lubricant part number: CFW-LUB-497.
   - Confirm the target set point for EQ-P1-L3-IH01 is 1235 °C and that actual process control is within acceptable limits per MM-P1-L3-IH01.
   - Record any deviation from nominal equipment state and any temporary protective measures applied.

3. Process and material status
   - List in-process billets, their current process step, and any special instructions for heat soak, machining, or inspection.
   - Document the last measured dimensions or NDT results that affect the next steps.
   - If any billets have been segregated for rework or scrap, identify their location and reason.

4. Quality and measurement handover
   - Review last shift’s sampling and inspection records.
   - Confirm acceptance criteria applied during last shift and any concessions or nonconforming part dispositions.
   - Ensure the next shift has access to any open quality actions and the responsible contacts.

5. Maintenance and technical actions
   - Review outstanding maintenance tasks and their priority as documented in ECN-2026-008.
   - Confirm any temporary repairs, bypasses, or mitigations have been documented and authorized by maintenance or engineering.
   - If any specific tooling or fixture adjustments were made, document the change and reference MM-P1-L3-IH01 for machine-specific instructions.

6. Safety and housekeeping
   - Confirm all safety incidents have been reported per QS-PROC-04 and that corrective actions are in place.
   - Check that work areas around EQ-P1-L3-IH01, EQ-P1-L3-HP02, and EQ-P1-L3-CN03 are free of trip hazards and that required barriers are in place.
   - Verify fire suppression and emergency access routes are unobstructed.

7. Examples and scenarios
   - Example: If the outgoing operator reports a recurring temperature drift on EQ-P1-L3-IH01, the oncoming operator should verify the controller displays the target 1235 °C and note any deviation. If deviation persists, escalate per ECN-2026-008.
   - Example: If a low-lube warning was observed on EQ-P1-L3-HP02, verify lubricant type is CFW-LUB-497 and the reservoir level; if replenished, document batch or lot per MM-P1-L3-IH01 records.

8. Records to complete
   - Shift log entry with summary of verbal handover.
   - Equipment check form for EQ-P1-L3-IH01, EQ-P1-L3-HP02, EQ-P1-L3-CN03.
   - Quality checklist and any nonconformance reports filed per QS-PROC-04.
   - Maintenance request entries for pending actions referenced by ECN-2026-008.

9. Acceptance and acknowledgment
   - The oncoming operator repeats back critical items: active nonconformances, in-process billet status, any temporary modifications, and confirmation of lubricant and target temperature values.
   - Both outgoing and oncoming operators sign the shift log and initial the equipment check forms.

Sign-off (required)
- Outgoing operator name / signature / time (enter in shift log).
- Oncoming operator name / signature / time (enter in shift log).
- Supervisor or lead acknowledgment if non-routine issues or maintenance pending (enter in shift log).

Post-handover follow-up
- The oncoming operator performs a short verification run to confirm stable operation and records results in the shift log.
- Any unresolved items requiring escalation are routed to maintenance or engineering per ECN-2026-008 and documented.

References
- ECN-2026-008
- MM-P1-L3-IH01
- QS-PROC-04

Revision history
- Current revision: Rev D.
